text.content:
A majority of Sharpshooters are exceptionally good at dealing with threats from a carefully calculated distance.

SKILLS

BARRAGE

When you perform a ranged attack, you may spend 10 Mind Points to choose one option: the attack gains multi (2); or you increase the attack's multi property by one, up to a maximum of multi (3).

CROSSFIRE

After a creature you can see performs an Accuracy Check for a ranged attack, you may spend an amount of Mind Points equal to (5 + the Result of that Accuracy Check) to have the attack automatically miss all of its targets. You can only use this Skill if you have a ranged weapon equipped, and it has no effect if the Accuracy Check was a critical success.

HAWKEYE · SL max 5

When you perform the Guard action, if you choose not to provide cover to another creature, you may choose one option: the next ranged attack you perform before the end of the current scene will deal (SL × 3) extra damage; or you may perform a free attack with a bow or firearm you have equipped, treating your High Roll as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack.

RANGED WEAPON MASTERY · SL max 4

You gain a bonus equal to (SL) to all Accuracy Checks with ranged weapons.

WARNING SHOT · SL max 4

When you hit one or more targets with a ranged attack that deals damage, you may have the attack deal no damage. If you do, choose one option: inflict shaken on each target hit by the attack; or inflict slow on each target hit by the attack; or each target hit by the attack loses (SL × 10) Mind Points. Describe your maneuver!

KEEN VISION · SL max 5

When your group makes a travel roll and encounters a danger, choose one: each other member of the group receives a bonus equal to (SL) on the next Check they make that isn't part of an attack or offensive (O) spell; or each other member of the group takes (SL × 2) less damage from the next instance of damage that would affect them. This reduction increases to (SL × 3) if you are level 20 or higher, and (SL × 4) if you are level 40 or higher.

A character loses this benefit if it is not used before your next travel roll or rest.

THE WANTED LIST · SL max 6

When you rest in a populated area, you can ask the GM for an open bounty. The GM will provide a target and a condition for fulfilling that bounty (capture them alive, chase them to a specific location, defeat them while they're suffering from a certain status effect, etc.). If you meet that condition before your next rest, you gain (SL × 100) zenit.
